title: "Outside the workshop"

The section "Going further" at the end of the report in the IDE workspace holds three more exercises. The modules of the [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) each stand on their own, so take the one you need and leave the rest.

- [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd)
- [Audit experiments](../../companion/experiments.qmd)
- [Binary outcomes](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd)
- [Bayesian estimation](../../companion/bayesian.qmd)
- [Meta-analysis](../../companion/meta-analysis.qmd)
- [Subgroups and multiple comparisons](../../companion/subgroups.qmd)
- [Missing values](../../companion/missingness.qmd)
- [Causal graphs and adjustment sets](../../companion/dags.qmd)
- [Building the analysis file](../../companion/data-management.qmd)
- [Quarto documents](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html)
- [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), then [Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html)

The final report of the replication in the SCORE replicability study is at [osf.io/2ug8x](https://osf.io/2ug8x/), and its de-identified data, do-file and dictionary are at [osf.io/xseqg](https://osf.io/xseqg/). The [background page](../../background.qmd) and the [resources page](../../resources.qmd) give the sources of the case study.
